verses.1782: falā budda min shakwā ʾilā llāhi kurbatī famāliyā ghayra llāhi jābiru kasratī
verses.1783: wa qarʿiyā bāba l-ghayri yā rabbi lam yufid lidhāka ṣarafnā naḥwa bābika wijhatī
verses.1784: faʾanta karīmu fal-karīmu mani t-tajā ʾilā bābihi yaʾa man ʿalā kulli niqmahi
verses.1785: faʾanta ḥalīmu yā ṣabūru liman jafā fahā ʾanā ʿabdu jiʾitu bādiyā dhillahi
verses.1786: falammā badā lī ʾannahu laysa mahrabu siwā bābika l-ḥāmī madadtu yudayyatī
verses.1787: ʾilayka biḍuʿfi wāftiqāri wafāqati litaghfira lī yā rabbi min kulli zallatī
verses.1788: fabayna yaday mawlāyā māziltu wāqifā dhalīlā ḥaqīrā mustaghīthā lishiddatī
verses.1789: faʾanta ʾilahī yā mujību liman daʿā daʿawtuka yā sattāru fāstur maʿībatī
verses.1790: fayā rabbanā iṣrif ʾilayka khawāṭirī bijāhi nabiyyi lil-bariyyati raḥmahi
verses.1791: fayā ḥayyū yā qayyūmu yā llāhu rabbanā ʾilayka tawassalnā bikhayri l-bariyyati
verses.1792: wa shaffiʿhu fīnā fī lliqāʾi wa kullunā siwā l-ḥibbi mawṣūfu biruʿbi warahbahi
verses.1793: bīʾādama ʾidrīsi wa hūdi wa yūnusi wa lūṭi wa nūḥi thumma ḥāwi likhullahi
verses.1794: wa dāwūda yaʿqūbi sulaymāna yūsufi wa ʾisḥāqa ʾismāʿīla ʾilyāsa junnatī
verses.1795: wa mūsā wa hārūni wa ʾayyūba wal-yasaʿ wadhī l-kifli yaḥyā thumma ʿīsā l-wasīlati
verses.1796: kadhā zakariyāʾu shuʿaybu wa ṣāliḥu taqīnā radā d-dārayni min kulli waḥlahi
verses.1797: wamin ʾāli bayti l-muṣṭafā jamʿu shamlinā biʾaṣḥābihi kashfu sh-shidādi l-muhībati
verses.1798: biʾaqmāri badri yā ʾilahī wa sayyidī wa bil-malaʾi l-ʾaʿlā kshifan kulla ghummahi
verses.1799: ʾilahiyā yā mawlāyā bil-ʾarḍi wa s-samā wa mā ḥawatā faltashfinā kulla ʿillahi
verses.1800: laka l-khalqu yā mawlāyā wa l-ʾamru kulluhu wa lā takilan ʾamrī lighayrika dhukhratī
verses.1801: mashāriba ʾahli l-ḥaḍratayni litasqinā ʾazil biḥijābi l-qalbi maʿ kulli qaswati
verses.1802: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayāmu wadh-dhanbu ḥāṣilu wa ṣāḥa ghurābu l-bayni muʿlima riḥlatī
verses.1803: maḍā d-dahru wa l-ʾayāmu wa l-jismu ʿābidu siwā llāhi wa r-raḥmānu khāliqu juththatī
verses.1804: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayāmu wa l-qalbu shākiru siwāhu wa minhu d-dahra jalbu maʿīshatī
verses.1805: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayāmu wadh-dhanbu ḥāṣilu ʿalā ʾannanī mamlūku nafsī wa shahwatī
verses.1806: ʾalā ʿumru wallā mustaṭāʿu rujūʿuhu faʾarʾaba mā ʾathʾaytu sāʿata ghirratī
verses.1807: laqad ḍāʿa ʿumru sāʿata minhu tushtarā bimilʾi s-samā wa l-ʾarḍi ʾayyata ḍayʿati
verses.1808: wa lakinnanī ʾarjū talāfiyā rabbanā wa ʾillā fahabnī hālikā ʾayyā hulkahi
verses.1809: ʾalā himmatī fājʿal ʾilahī ʿaliyyata liʾan ṣirtu ḥurrā khāliṣā kulla wijhahi
verses.1810: fayā rabbi ʾammā kuntu ghayraka ʾartajī famā ban-nā yawma l-jazāʾi waḥīlatī
verses.1811: ʾalā khāba ʾāmālī lighayrika rabbanā kamā nghalaqat ʾillā ʾilayka ṭarīqatī
verses.1812: wa māliyā rabbī ʿan qaḍāʾika maʿdilu fahabniyā ʾan ʾarḍā bimarri l-qaḍiyyati
verses.1813: wa hab liyā fī l-ʾamri th-thabāta ʿazīmata ʿalā r-rushdi hab lī sh-shukra min kulli niʿmahi
verses.1814: wa ʾasʾaluka t-taqwā wa ḥusna ʿibādati wa nayla marāmī yā ʾilahī wa bughyatī
verses.1815: wa ʾasʾalu rabbī llāha min khayri kullimā bihi ʿālimu ghawthī ʿimādī wa nuṣratī
verses.1816: ʾaʿūdhu bika ṭ-ṭaghwā wa min sharri kullimā ʿalimta bihi yā rabbi jābira kasratī
verses.1817: wa ʾastaghfiru l-ghaffāra min sharri kullimā bihi ʿālimu yā ʿālimā kulla khubʾatī
verses.1818: faʾinnaka ʾanta l-ʿālimu l-ghaybi kullihi saʾaltuka ʾamnā yā naṣīrī wa ʿizzatī
verses.1819: ʾalā ḥasbunā llāhu l-jalīlu jalālata wa niʿma l-wakīlu llāhu nawwir baṣīratī
verses.1820: ʾaʿūdhu birabbī l-hādi min jawri jāʾiri wa min makri ʿādi mākiri ʾayyā makratī
verses.1821: wa ẓulmi liẓallāmi wa siḥri lisāḥiri wa baghyi libāghi yā ʾilahī wa ʿuddatī
verses.1822: kadhā ḥasadu l-ḥussādi ghadru lighādiri wa kaydu likulli l-kāʾidīna bihulkahi
verses.1823: kadhāka ʾilaha l-ʿālamīna ʿadāwatu likulli ʿaduwwi yabtaghī d-dahra ṣawlatī
verses.1824: wa ṭaʿnu liṭaʿʿāni wa qadḥu liqādiḥi wa min ḥiyali l-muḥtāli min ʾayyī ḥīlati
verses.1825: shamātatu shammāti wa kashḥu likāshiḥi ʾilahī qinā fī d-dahri kulla baliyyati
verses.1826: ʾaṣūlu bika l-ʾaʿdā kadhā quranāʾanā wa ʾiyāka ʾarjū min walāʾi l-ʾaḥibbahi
verses.1827: wa min qurabāʾī yā ʾilāhī wa sayyidī laka l-ḥamdu mimmā laysa tuḥṣīhi qudratī
verses.1828: walā ʿaddahu ʿaddu ʿawāʾida faḍlika l-ʿamīmi wa min ʿawāriqi r-rizqi sitratī
verses.1829: wa ʾalwānu mā ʾawlaytanī rabbanā bihi mina r-rifdi wa l-ʾikrāmi wāsiʿa raḥmahi
verses.1830: ʾilāhiyā lā rabbu siwāka fayurtajā faʾinnaka fāshī l-ḥamdi ʿinda l-khalīqati
verses.1831: wa ʾanta ʾilāhī bāsiṭu l-yadi fī n-nadā wa ghayru muḍāddi yā ʾilāhī biḥikmahi
verses.1832: wafī l-ʾamri was-sulṭāni wal-mulki lā munā ziʿu laka mawlānā fayassir bimunyati
verses.1833: famā laka mawlānā ʾilāhī mushāriku rubūbiyyata rabbī ghiyāthī wa ʿumdatī
verses.1834: wa fī l-khalqi yā mawlāyā ghāru muzāḥami liʾannaka fī l-ʾibdāʿi mawṣūfu waḥdati
verses.1835: wa ʾanta mina l-ʾakhlāqi tamliku mā tashā wa lā yamlikūna minka ghayra l-mashīʾati
verses.1836: ʾilahī biquṭbi l-ʿārifīna ʾimāminā rajāʾī wa ghawthī lil-ʾilahi wasīlatī
verses.1837: khitāmi niẓāmi lil-wilāyati jumlaha bihi ʾartajī l-ghufrāna min kulli zallahi
verses.1838: bihi ʾartajī fatḥa l-maghāliqi kullihā wiqāyatunā t-tijāni min kulli shiddati
verses.1839: wa kam ʾashtakī ʿinda l-ʾilahi ziyārata zawāyāhu lakinna l-ʿināna biqabḍaḍi
verses.1840: ʾunādī wa hal yujdī n-nidāʾu ʾakhā l-jawā hali d-dahru yuʿṭīnī murādī waraghbatī
verses.1841: wa mā ziltu ʾarjūhā mina llāhi waḥdahu wa ʾin lam ʾanalhā yā marārata ʿīshatī
verses.1842: waʿadta wa ʾanta l-waʿdu ʿindaka ṣādiqu ʾijābata dāʿi dhī ḍṭirāri wa dhillahi
verses.1843: ʾilahiyā fāʿfu l-wālidīna dhunūbahum kadhalika yā raḥmānu kulla l-mashīkhati
verses.1844: kadhalika ʾikhwānī ʾilahiyā jumlaha waman yantamī rabbī ʾilā khayri millatī
verses.1845: wa ʾazkā ṣalāti llāhi thumma salāmihi ʿalā khayri khalqi llāhi min ghayri thunyati
verses.1846: maʿa l-ʾāli wa l-ʾaṣḥābi mā dharra shāriqu wa mā qāla dāʿi yā ʾilahī lishiddatī
